title: A Protocol for Using Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (FRET)-force Biosensors to Measure Mechanical Forces across the Nuclear LINC Complex
protocol: Obtain Nesprin-2G TS, Nesprin-2G HL control, mTFP1, venus, and TSmod from a commercial source.
Propagate all the DNA plasmids using standard E. coli strains such as DH5-α.
Grow NIH 3T3 fibroblasts cells to 70-90% confluence in a 6-well cell culture dish.
Remove the medium and rinse each well with approximately 1 mL of reduced-serum cell medium.
Add 800 μL of reduced-serum cell medium to each well.
Pipette 700 µL of reduced-serum cell medium into a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 35 µL of lipid carrier solution to the tube and mix by pipetting.
Label the tube with an "L".
Gather six 1.5 mL tubes and label them 1 through 6.
Pipette 100 µL of reduced-serum cell medium into each tube.
Pipette 2 µg of Nesprin-2G-TS into tubes 1 and 2.
Pipette 2 µg of Nesprin-HL into tubes 3 and 4.
Pipette 1 µg of mTFP into tube 5.
Pipette 1 µg of mVenus into tube 6.
Do not re-use pipette tips when pipetting different types of DNA.
Pipette 100 µL of the lipomix from the "L" tube into each labeled tube (1-6).
Mix by repeated pipetting.
Incubate for 10-20 min.
Add 200 µL from each labeled tube to a well in the 6-well chamber with 70-90% confluent cells.
Label the top of each well with the corresponding DNA added.
Place the 6-well chamber in an incubator for 4-6 h.
Aspirate the medium and add 1-2 mL of reduced-serum cell medium to rinse.
Aspirate the reduced-serum cell medium, add 2 mL of trypsin to each well, and place the 6-well dish in the incubator (5-15 min).
While the cells detach in the incubator, coat 6 glass-bottom viewing dishes with a layer of fibronectin at a concentration of 20 µg/mL dissolved in phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Allow the dishes to coat the surface in the cell culture hood (approximately 20 min).
Neutralize the trypsin by adding 2 mL of DMEM once the cells are detached.
Transfer the contents of each well to a labeled 15-mL centrifuge tube and spin down at 90 x g for 5 min in a swinging rotor centrifuge.
Aspirate the supernatant and re-suspend each cell pellet in 1,000 µL of DMEM by pipette mixing.
Aspirate the fibronectin mixture from the glass dishes.
Pipette 1,000 µL of each cell suspension onto the glass dishes.
Add another 1 mL of DMEM + 10% FBS + 1% Pen-Strep to each well.
Place the dish in the cell incubator.
Allow cells to attach and express sensor for at least 18-24 hours.
Transfect cells using commercial cationic lipid transfection reagents.
Alternatively, select stable cell lines using a plasmid conferring resistance to a toxin.
Use pcDNA plasmids for Nesprin-TS available on a DNA repository website.
Generate additional cells expressing Nesprin HL zero-force control as described in steps 2.1-2.12.
Transfect cells with mTFP1 and venus to generate spectral fingerprints as per step 4.
Adjust the amount of DNA transfected for Nesprin-TS to match expression levels of mTFP1 and venus.
Use an inverted fluorescent microscope to examine the efficiency of transfection by comparing the number of fluorescent cells to the total number of cells in view (usually 5-30%).
Equip the microscope with an excitation frequency near 462 nm (mTFP1) or 525 nm (venus) and an emission filter centered near 492 nm (mTFP1) or 525 nm (venus).
Image live cells within 48 h after transfection.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde (in PBS with calcium and magnesium) for 5 min, store in PBS, and view after 48 h.
Replace the cell medium with imaging medium (HEPES-buffered) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum.
Place the glass viewing dish with mTFP1-transfected cells over the oil objective at 60X magnification.
Locate mTFP1 expressing cells using a 458 nm excitation source and an emission bandpass filter centered at 500 nm.
Select spectral detection mode in the software ("Lambda Mode").
Capture the spectral image including all frequencies beyond 458 nm using 10 nm increments.
Select a bright fluorescent region (ROI) on the cell with a 20-pixel radius.
Add the fluorescent ROI mean, normalized intensity to the spectral database by clicking "save spectra to database."
Optimize the laser power and gain for good signal-to-noise ratio.
Use non-fluorescent, untransfected cells as a background reference.
Increase the gain and power until cells are bright without saturation.
Background cells should not have detectable fluorescence after averaging.
Ensure excitation frequency is at 515 nm when locating venus-expressing cells.
Center bandpass filter near 530 nm for venus expression detection.
In "Spectral Mode," use an excitation frequency of 515 nm.
Switch capturing mode to "Spectral Unmixing."
Add spectral fingerprints of venus and mTFP1 into unmixing channels.
Set the excitation laser back to a 458 nm argon source.
Place Nesprin-TS viewing dish above the 60X oil objective.
Adjust gain and laser power for optimal signal-to-noise ratio on fluorescent cells.
Capture a minimum of 15-20 images of Nesprin-TS cells with relatively similar brightness and avoid excessive pixel saturation.
Repeat the image capturing process with Nesprin-HL cells using identical imaging parameters.
